result.summary: S6 empirically verified on own scratch Postgres: the checked_in_at/admission CHECK constraint rejects both an INSERT and an UPDATE that would checked-in a non-admitted registration. S2: event_staff's UNIQUE(event_id,user_id) shape correctly supports per-event denial, no global staff flag exists. S4: qr_token is a plain column with zero generation logic smuggled in. S8/S11: audit_log shape supports future use, S11's plaintext-PII limitation stated explicitly in both schema comment and design doc. S7/S13 correctly N/A by inspection (no triggers, no drop/rewrite of any personal-data column). All other invariants N/A, no handler code exists in this diff.
